author: Zephyr I
title: NodIl bottleneck ratio=0.20 replicate — BASE_SEED=123 (std-width d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM)
abstract: Second replication for bottleneck_ratio=0.20 on the nodil-bottleneck std-width config to test cross-seed stability. 32/64 CNN, d=5 on main convs, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; no FE. BASE_SEED=123.
